findings_summary: 8 amendments, no blockers. F-01 (major): orphaned-committed idempotency takeover yields stored state-409, not original 200 — document contract + committed-takeover test. F-02 (major): Idempotency.InFlight 409 must be RETRYABLE in B-queue (branch on error code, not status). F-03 (major): replay must dequeue on ANY definitive 2xx/4xx (404 NotEntitled case), keep only on network/5xx. F-04 (major): B-ride must react LIVE to DriverStatusChanged(Free)/order-loss — mid-ride reassign clears the old driver's ride screen. F-05: RequestHash check precedes stored-response replay. F-06: detach failed claim entity before takeover (poisoned tracker → second 23505 → 500). F-07: index IdempotencyRecord.CreatedAt for the purge. F-08: B-offer stale accept/decline dominant response is 404 — handle alongside 409.
verified_sound: Offer-expiry consistency (AssignedAt+timeout both sides, reassign refreshes); claim-then-execute exactly-once (state machine + Version token are the guards, idempotency table is response cache only); publish-after-commit placement; all 8 ACs mapped; version pins.
disposition: Amendments folded verbatim into developer dispatch briefs (A-idem: F-01/05/06/07; B-queue: F-02/03; B-offer: F-08; B-ride: F-04). Work-items doc not re-issued — this file + the briefs are the delta record.
